talents.name: Improved Sinister Strike

ranks.description: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike ability by 5.

talents.iconHint: Purple glowing vial / ritual dagger; green border; spent badge 2
talents.diffNotes: Tip shows Rank 2/2 text matching Classic rank 2 (+5 Energy reduction) and maxRank 2. Rank 1 Forever text not captured.

talents.name: Improved Eviscerate

ranks.description: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 7%.

talents.iconHint: Red/brown hooded figure; leftmost of Combat row0 trio
talents.diffNotes: Moved into Combat (Classic Assassination r0c0). Rank 1 is +7% (Classic was +5%). maxRank still 3.

talents.name: Precision

ranks.description: Increases your chance to hit with all attacks and Poisons by 1%.

talents.iconHint: Mostly obscured; tip crop shows little tree context
talents.diffNotes: Combat confirmed by class context of tip set. Slot not reliably placed from tip crop (row/col null). Forever R1 hits all attacks and Poisons at maxRank 3; Classic was melee-only hit, maxRank 5.

talents.name: Deflection
talents.iconHint: Silver parrying blade; under Imp Sinister Strike
talents.diffNotes: Combat header visible. R1 is +2% Parry at maxRank 3; Classic R1 was +1% Parry at maxRank 5.

talents.name: Puncturing Wounds

ranks.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 10% and your Mutilate by 5%, and gives Backstab a 15% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match (related idea to Improved Backstab id 202, but Forever name/text includes Mutilate + extra CP chance). Sits where Classic Precision often was.

talents.name: Improved Sprint

ranks.description: Gives a 50% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.
Gives a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.

talents.iconHint: Red/orange winged boot with motion lines
talents.diffNotes: Tip Rank 1/2 shows R1 text and Next Rank R2 text matching Classic Improved Sprint.

talents.name: Endurance

ranks.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 30%.

talents.diffNotes: Forever R1 is 30% cooldown reduction; Classic used flat 45 sec / 1.5 min reductions. maxRank still 2.

talents.name: Dual Wield Specialization

ranks.description: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 5%.

talents.iconHint: Crossed daggers; arrow from Puncturing Wounds above
talents.diffNotes: R1 is +5% off-hand (Classic R1 was +10%). maxRank still 5. Requires talent above (Puncturing Wounds at 3 in spent tip).

talents.name: Restless Blades

ranks.description: Your damaging finishing moves reduce the remaining cooldown of your Adrenaline Rush, Blade Flurry, Evasion, Sprint, and Vanish abilities by 2 sec per combo point.

talents.iconHint: Crossed swords; lower Combat column near Hack and Slash neighbors
talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match. Combat inferred from tip-set neighbors. Exact row/col not confidently fixed from tip crop — left null.

talents.name: Hack and Slash

ranks.description: Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 1% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target. Dagger/Fist: Increases your critical strike chance by 1%. Mace: Your attacks ignore 3% of your target's armor.

Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 2% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target. Dagger/Fist: Increases your critical strike chance by 2%. Mace: Your attacks ignore 6% of your target's armor.

talents.iconHint: Gauntleted hand on sword; under Dual Wield in col2
talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match (weapon-type proc talent). Tip shows Rank 1/5 plus Next Rank. Combat header visible. Col2 chain: bald face → Puncturing Wounds → Dual Wield → Hack and Slash.

talents.name: Weapon Expertise

ranks.description: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 1%.
Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 2%.

talents.iconHint: Crossed swords; near Blade Flurry in tip crop
talents.diffNotes: Forever R1/R2 are dodge/parry chance reductions; Classic was Sword/Fist/Dagger skill. maxRank still 2. Row/col best-effort near Blade Flurry.

talents.name: Aggression

ranks.description: Increases the damage of your Sinister Strike, Backstab, and Eviscerate abilities by 2%.

talents.iconHint: Lower Combat; tip shows neighbors with spent ranks 4/5
talents.diffNotes: Forever R1 includes Backstab (Classic was Sinister Strike and Eviscerate only). maxRank still 3. Slot best-effort.

talents.name: Blade Flurry

ranks.description: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Active tip shows 25 Energy, Instant, 2 min CD, +20% melee speed and cleave for 15 sec. Classic wording differed slightly (attack speed / additional nearby opponent). Slot best-effort in lower Combat mid-column.

layoutNotes: Coverage is incomplete: public/rogue/ has overview.png + rogue/1.png–13.png only.
All 13 tooltip screenshots are Combat. Assassination occupied slots: 18 with ZERO tooltips. Subtlety occupied slots: 19 with ZERO tooltips.

Combat tip set covers 13 named talents; several occupied Combat slots still lack tips (row0 col2 bald face; row1 col0 claw/gauntlet; row2 col1 under Deflection; row3 col0/col1; row4 col2; row6 col1 capstone).
Precision and Restless Blades have tip text but row/col left null where placement was not clear from the tip crop.
Do not invent Assassination/Subtlety names or descriptions until more screenshots exist.
Lower-tree Combat row/col for Blade Flurry / Weapon Expertise / Aggression are best-effort from tip neighbors + overview occupancy — re-verify when more tips land.
Improved Eviscerate appears in Combat forever (not Assassination) per rogue/2.png neighbors matching Combat row0.
